claim: *In-flight ownership model.* A current claim records owner, epoch, and lifetime. Completion releases the claim; expiry makes it reclaimable. The model distinguishes a live claim from a stale one without representing the storage machinery that implements the lease.

topology.description: Claimed lease completes or expires; expired lease can be reclaimed by another actor.

required_terms: A live claim is distinguishable from a stale one.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: Claim opens CLAIMED with owner, epoch and expires_at. Completion leads to RELEASED; expiry leads to RECLAIMABLE. A return transition allows another actor to claim again. The state model distinguishes live and stale claims without showing the storage implementation. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
